steps.en: Hirer notices due for the third letter are picked for printing
steps.id: Notice hirer yang jatuh tempo untuk surat ketiga dipilih untuk dicetak
steps.why_en: The daily run that picks them is switched off in the system; letters only start when someone triggers them by hand.
steps.why_id: Proses harian yang memilihnya dimatikan di sistem; surat baru jalan kalau dipicu manual oleh orang.

steps.en: The letter should carry the hirer's newest name and address
steps.id: Surat seharusnya memuat nama dan alamat hirer yang terbaru
steps.why_en: A newer address is used only if none is marked, and a hirer with only a furnished address may miss the letter.
steps.why_id: Alamat baru hanya dipakai kalau belum ada yang ditandai, dan hirer dengan alamat furnish saja bisa tidak dapat surat.

steps.en: A print data file for the third letter is built for the vendor
steps.id: File data cetak surat ketiga dibuat untuk vendor

steps.en: The file goes to the vendor over a secure file transfer
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor lewat transfer file yang aman
steps.why_en: Sending to the vendor is blocked by a setting, so the file may not reach them.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dikunci oleh satu setting, jadi file bisa tidak sampai.

steps.en: Once sent, the notice moves on to the next step in the workflow
steps.id: Setelah terkirim, notice maju ke tahap berikutnya di alur kerja
steps.why_en: The notice moves on even when the file was never delivered, because the delivery check is skipped.
steps.why_id: Notice tetap maju walau file tidak pernah terkirim, karena pengecekan pengiriman dilewati.
